page_data.en:
S. M. REGISTER.
No. D 5791.
March 4, 1937.
Date 4 / 3 / 37

- 5 -
Miscellaneous
Joint meeting of Chiefs of Disciplinary Training
Departments of local Colleges and Universities

Between 2 p.m. and 4.30 p.m. March 4, 1937, some
thirty chiefs of Disciplinary Training Departments of
various colleges and universities in Shanghai held a
joint meetin in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. Building, 123
Boulevard de Montigny. Chiang Kien-pah (蒋建白),
Chief of the 5th Section of the Bureau of Social Affairs,
presided and during an opening speech advocated strict
control over students in various local colleges and
universities. The following resolutions were discussed
and passed :-

1. That attention should be paid to the military education
of the students.
2. That compulsory physical training be enforced.
3. That measures be devised to prevent students from
frequenting dance halls.
4. That as an example to the students, teachers should
wear uniform in school.

S. M. 登记簿。
编号 D 5791。
1937年3月4日。
日期 4 / 3 / 37

- 5 -
杂项
上海各大专院校训育主任联席会议

1937年3月4日下午2时至4时30分，上海各大专院校约三十名训育主任在蒙蒂尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）123号中华基督教青年会大楼举行联席会议。社会局第五科科长蒋建白（Chiang Kien-pah）主持会议，并在开幕致辞中主张对上海各大专院校学生实行严格管控。会议讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 应重视学生的军事教育。
2. 强制执行体育训练。
3. 制定措施防止学生频繁出入舞厅。
4. 教师在校内应穿着制服，以为学生表率。

| 中等 | $11.70 | $10.00 |
| 普通 | $11.00 | $ 9.00 |

（批：5791）

Kim Bow

D.5791
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5791.
Date 4 / 10 / 35
October 4, 1935.

Inspection of primary and middle schools

On October 3, 1935, the local Tangpu detailed six
staff members to inspect various primary and middle schools
in Nantao. The object of this inspection is to observe
the manner in which lessons on citizens' education and
Kuomintang propaganda are taught, and to enquire into
the formation of students' organizations.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处登记簿。
编号 D 5791。
日期 4 / 10 / 35
1935年10月4日。

视察中小学

1935年10月3日，本地塘沽路巡捕房派出六名职员视察南市各中小学。此次视察的目的是观察公民教育课程及国民党宣传内容的授课方式，并调查学生组织的成立情况。

page_data.en:
D.5791

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5791.
Date 23 / 2 / 35）

February 23, 1935.

Local Kuomintang - investigation of local schools

The local Kuomintang Headquarters has appointed
nine of its members, including Wong Lung Tsang (王龍章)
and Tsu Wah Kwei (朱亞揆), to proceed to various
middle and primary schools in Shanghai With a view to
investigation the propagation of the Kuomintang principles
in these institutions. It is reported that these
delegates will carry out their functions commencing
from February 25.

1935年2月23日。

本地国民党——调查本地学校

本地国民党党部已指派包括王龍章（Wong Lung Tsang）和朱亞揆（Tsu Wah Kwei）在内的九名成员，前往上海各中学和小学，以调查这些机构中三民主义原则的传播情况。据悉，这些代表将从2月25日开始履行其职责。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File & S.B. REGISTRY. No. D 5791 Date 10 / 4 / 34）
Date April 9, 1934

Subject (in full) Local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Education
- to assume control over procters and teachers
of civics in local schools.

Made by D.S. Mad Adie Forwarded by Whounean DSS

The local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Education have
jointly formed a "Shanghai Municipality School Procters and
Teachers of Civics Qualification Censorship Committee" with
an office in the Tangpu Headquarters, Feng Ling Chiao, off
Route Ghisi. The Committee on April 8 issued a circular
notification to those concerned in local middle schools to
register with the Committee within three months commencing
from April 10.

R. W. Mac adie
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Copy sent

报告

日期 1934年4月9日

主题（全称） 本地国民党与教育局——接管本地学校训育员及公民教员的控制权。

由 D.S. Mad Adie 制作 经 Whounean DSS 转发

本地国民党与教育局联合成立了“上海市学校训育员及公民教员资格审查委员会”，办事处设在吉司斐路（Route Ghisi）旁凤林桥的塘沽路总部。该委员会于4月8日向本地各中学相关人员发出通函通知，要求自4月10日起三个月内向委员会登记注册。

R. W. Mac adie
副督察长 (D. S.)

特别处主管警官。

（批：归档
副本已送
教育总监 Sme
J.B.）
